picks.name: Gehwol Refreshing Foot Balm
picks.description: This one doesn't advertise. Never had to. German-made, 140 years old, sold through podiatry offices and apothecaries like C.O. Bigelow on Sixth Avenue. The professionals don't recommend it on a website — they just reach for it themselves. So did we.

picks.name: Kneipp Healthy Feet Mineral Foot Bath Salt (Calendula & Rosemary) — 3-Pack
picks.description: Not a lot of people know about this one. 125-year-old German formula, pulled from ancient sea deposits, built as a pre-treatment step before the balm. The guys who know, know. Now you do too.

picks.name: MR.GREEN 8-in-1 Manicure & Pedicure Kit
picks.description: German stainless steel. Anti-splash clippers. Leather case. Eight tools, zero you won't use. The kind of kit you leave out on purpose.

picks.name: MARLOWE. No. 102 Scrub Bar
picks.description: Triple-milled. Agarwood, Oud, Santal. The shower has been doing half a job and you've been letting it. This fixes that. Start at the feet, work up. By morning you'll wonder what took you so long.

picks.name: L'Occitane Shea Butter Intensive Foot Balm
picks.description: 25% shea butter. Fast-absorbing, non-greasy. A Provence apothecary formula that's been earning its place for decades. The guys who know what they're putting on their skin reach for this one.
